findings.finding: 制作资料正文主要是剧情事实；沈默缺主立绘、五视图、六头部角度、服饰拆解和材质色卡版式，场景缺主全景与局部特写同画布构图，道具缺独立物件图片构图。未知造型不能解释省略版式。画外角色只需身份和声音，不据此强制补视觉设计。
四场正文均为摘要，没有包含整体设定、连续性及该场所属镜头全文。
缺用户规定的完整视听正文组织和细节密度，时间轴只在timing而未落实到prompt，多处机位、构图、光照及动作节拍不足。标签检测仅辅助，不能代替语义阅读。
客服和录音者均明确offscreen，却分别出现在references.characters视觉绑定中。说话者独立身份比前轮改善，但视觉绑定仍错。
工作手机、自行车和外卖箱未独立创建或确认复用；前两镜props为空，后两镜只有旧手机。
通话7–48秒承载约219汉字；46汉字客服句从37秒开始，41秒下一句，约11.5汉字/秒；41–42和44–45秒的相邻台词也过紧。52秒总长度和自然通话标签不解决内部矛盾。
未实际取餐却变为已取餐、抵站进入配送中等源事件未落实到镜头正文；骑行过程被摘要略过。第四镜重复收纳冲突比前轮改善。
Runtime接受11个目标，但session-constraints的8547字作为单一requirementId；代码只要求每个ID至少一条评估。每目标两条评估未覆盖全部适用义务，部分不完整制作正文仍被接受。

findings: 12 operations in one top-level anyOf tool
documents.kind=scene vs story scenes vs references.scenes
three arrays required even for partial material package
scene authoringIR optional; prompt only nonempty
No explicit strict field or response_format in this tool request path; provider support/default not proven
exact quotes and target/source evidence must be generated
read-only evidence version in receipts is invalid in input
Coverage tests at requirementId granularity; compound obligations can be omitted

recommendations: Use a dedicated creation result schema with unambiguous storyScenes/locationPrompts/shots/characters/props/voices and local-key bindings; isolate lifecycle fields from authored content.
Keep complete prompt text authoritative and verify required sections, source events and timing consistency; avoid independent duplicate creative representations.
If supported, use a strict-compatible schema and verify provider behavior; do not just add strict to the current complex schema.
Track individual original obligations and scope; review content separately and permit bounded targeted repairs.
Have Worker own deterministic validation, IDs, versions, sealing, atomic commit and independent readback; never infer semantic pass from valid JSON.
